organization_archetype: Brazilian accounting, legal, or consulting firm with recurring client document and fee collection workflows
processes_simulated: sequence reminders for missing client documents before recurring filing deadlines
choose timing and channel for professional-fee collection follow-up
select recovery action for stalled client-service requests
scenario_variants: contradictory payment, document, or client-contact state
peak period with many deadlines and reduced staff capacity
deterministic_baseline: fixed reminder ladders, due-date rules, client segmentation, templates, WhatsApp or email automation, escalation thresholds, and professional approval

training_data.observation_unit: one eligible client account or missing-document case at a defined decision time
training_data.input_data: only pre-action due date, prior contacts, channel availability, client relationship, document or invoice state, and permitted operational context
training_data.target_or_reward: document receipt or payment within a bounded window, adjusted for contact cost, complaints, opt-outs, and professional override
training_data.label_source: subsequent receipt or payment events plus verified communication outcomes
training_data.prediction_time: immediately before choosing an eligible reminder or escalation action
training_data.class_balance: unknown; successful outcomes and complaints may vary materially by client mix and workflow
training_data.historical_coverage: typically incomplete because fixed rules do not log alternative eligible actions or action propensities
training_data.train_validation_split: time-based and client-group separated, with policy-era separation
training_data.leakage_risks: using later payment, document receipt, manual escalation, revised due dates, or post-contact status fields
training_data.representativeness_risks: different firm sizes, client portfolios, service types, deadlines, channels, and relationship norms
training_data.feedback_loop: record action eligibility, selected action, propensity, delivery, response, outcome, complaint, opt-out, and human override
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: LGPD purpose limitation, communication consent and channel rules, professional confidentiality, minimal use of client content, and no inference of sensitive vulnerability
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: retain configurable deterministic reminder ladders and evaluate prospective randomized or phased tests only with governance approval

primary_training_data_risk: historical systems rarely preserve eligible alternatives and action propensities, so offline policy evaluation would be biased
existing_landscape: Brazilian legal and accounting platforms already automate fee and document reminders
general collection tools already provide configurable WhatsApp and email reminder ladders
the remaining contextual-policy layer would be an implementation experiment rather than a differentiated business opportunity
human_control: professionals define eligible actions, communication boundaries, escalation, exceptions, and relationship-sensitive decisions

notes: No opportunity published. The selected focus exposed a repeated decision with observable outcomes, but deterministic reminder ladders and current products already cover the operational core. A contextual policy would require prospective logging of eligible actions and propensities before credible offline evaluation.
